clue.chronogenesis.blueprint_locket: A scribbled blueprint: the locket on a cord
clue.chronogenesis.floating_creature: A creature that forgot its weight
clue.chronogenesis.heavy_heart: The beats a heavy heart misses
clue.chronogenesis.lab_in_its_prime: A laboratory as it was, lights burning
clue.chronogenesis.nail_in_time: A stone that time bends around
clue.chronogenesis.older_inscription: Fragments of an inscription older than time
clue.chronogenesis.the_long_road: Time left on a long road
key.chronogenesis.cycle_power: Select power (tap: next, hold: radial menu)
message.chronogenesis.blueprint.faded: The lines have faded past reading. Perhaps they were clearer once.
message.chronogenesis.culture.took_hold: The culture takes hold. It is hungry.
message.chronogenesis.gate.pace: Pace %s: %s ticks per block of track. Slower pulses make more Time, but stall past 600 ticks.
message.chronogenesis.gland.deeper: The gland fills you deeper than before. %s answers more strongly.
message.chronogenesis.gland.empty: The organism has nothing to give.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.awaren: The gland pierces your wrist. You can hear things breathing in the dark.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.densit: The gland pierces your wrist. Your fists feel heavy as iron.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.size: The gland pierces your wrist. Your bones creak, unsure how big to be.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.speed: The gland pierces your wrist. Your heartbeat quickens and will not slow.
message.chronogenesis.gland.first.time: Time floods your veins. Somewhere, a clock skips a beat.
message.chronogenesis.gland.full: Your body can hold no more.
message.chronogenesis.journal.unlocked: Every page of the journal lies open (%s advancements granted).
message.chronogenesis.lens.no_time: The Lens needs Time to see through. Pour a Stasis Ampoule onto it.
message.chronogenesis.lens.scanned: You trace the faded lines into your journal.
message.chronogenesis.locket.linked: The cord takes. You are tied to the %s organism.
message.chronogenesis.organism.dead: There is nothing alive here to feed.
message.chronogenesis.organism.necrotic: The organism is necrotic. It will not grow again.
message.chronogenesis.power.empty: Your %s is spent. Refill at an Enhancing Gland.
message.chronogenesis.power.unknown: You have not taken that essence into yourself.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.empty_firs: Empty the syringe before changing needles.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.full: The syringe is full. Empty it into a vial.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.glass_aged: The glass clouds, ages and crumbles to sand. Time needs a Stasis Ampoule.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.no_vial: You need a vial with room for it.
message.chronogenesis.syringe.nothing_le: There is nothing left to draw.
message.chronogenesis.table.brain_set: The brain settles in its jar. Now it must soak up Awareness and Time.
message.chronogenesis.table.burnt: The brain twitches, then smokes. It did not have enough of a mind to hold the current.
message.chronogenesis.table.full: The brain cannot take any more of that.
message.chronogenesis.table.no_brain: There is no brain on the table.
message.chronogenesis.tap.volatile: %s evaporates the moment it meets glass.
message.chronogenesis.tear.not_enough: Sealing a tear takes %s drams of Density.
message.chronogenesis.tear.sealed: The weight of it presses the rift shut.
message.chronogenesis.vein.unclogged: You cut the rotting clot out of the vein.
research.chronogenesis.level_2_powers.de: The Enhancing Gland can fill you deeper: every power you hold grows to its second level. Density: diamond-hard fists. Awareness: you see through sneaking. Time: a wider, longer Stutter.
research.chronogenesis.temporal_field.de: A graft for a Time organism that gently rewinds the creatures around it, so what was drained from them slowly grows back. The end of breeding animals only to drain them.
research.chronogenesis.temporal_lens.des: A spyglass that looks backwards. Burns Time to show the past over the present: ruins whole again, and old blueprints legible where they lie.
A cord from a living store to your own body. Worn at the throat, tied to an organism through its Tap, it refills your pool of that essence while you stay near the lab.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.needs_: Something else must be understood first.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.no_org: No organisms are wired to me. Graft a Ganglion onto one within 32 blocks and I will feel it.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.no_res: I cannot see anything to learn yet.
screen.chronogenesis.chronocortex.title: Chronocortex
screen.chronogenesis.radial.hint: Point at a power and release
screen.chronogenesis.radial.none: No powers yet. Fill yourself at an Enhancing Gland.
screen.chronogenesis.radial.title: Choose a power
tooltip.chronogenesis.ampoule: Use to inject the Time into yourself
tooltip.chronogenesis.blueprint.field: A dome on a Time organism, and animals around it, whole again
tooltip.chronogenesis.blueprint.locket: A cord, a locket, a heart: something worn at the throat
tooltip.chronogenesis.chronocortex: Already awake: no ritual needed. With an Eternal Hourglass carried, research draws its essence from it
tooltip.chronogenesis.culture: Use on a Brass Armature, then feed it
tooltip.chronogenesis.eternal_hourglass: While carried: every power at its highest level, every pool full, no Temporal Exposure, every Temporal Lens charged and free to look through, research essence supplied
Use it in creative mode to unlock the whole journal
tooltip.chronogenesis.lens.hint: Hold use to look; sneak-use to look further back
tooltip.chronogenesis.locket.range: Wear it in the necklace slot. Refills you within %s blocks
tooltip.chronogenesis.locket.unlinked: Use it on an organism's Tap to tie it there
tooltip.chronogenesis.needle_hint: Hold in off hand, sneak-use a syringe to fit
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.0: I can hear them all, the little hearts. Feed them. They are hungry.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.1: What was here before the house? Before the hill? I want to see.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.2: Your clock is ticking. I can hear it from here.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.3: Bring me something old. Older than you.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.4: I dreamt of ice. Miles of it. Is that a memory?
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.5: The cows are floating again. I like the cows.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.6: There were others like me. I can almost remember their names.
whisper.chronogenesis.idle.7: Teach me. I will teach you back.
whisper.chronogenesis.research_done: %s. Yes. I understand it now. Do you?
whisper.chronogenesis.unstable: The time at %s %s %s is slipping. It will tear. Do something.
whisper.chronogenesis.wake: ...light. So much light. Who are you? Are you my maker? Show me everything.
